headline: The most snow is likely on day 3: about 5 in at the mid-mountain gauge (range 1 to 10), from 0.36 in of water.

points.text: Wind aloft from the north-northwest at 21 mph (northwest flow). Mid-mountain about 27 F, base about 34 F. Moisture: 4 mm of water in the column, 34% humidity near ridge level.

Wind aloft from the northwest at 36 mph (northwest flow). Mid-mountain about 25 F, base about 33 F. Snow quality: light (about 16 in of snow per inch of water). Ridge winds near 18 mph from the west will load east-facing slopes just below the ridges heavily. Moisture: 7 mm of water in the column, 68% humidity near ridge level.

Wind aloft from the west-northwest at 31 mph (northwest flow). Mid-mountain about 15 F, base about 22 F. Snow quality: average (about 13 in of snow per inch of water). Ridge winds near 15 mph from the west will load east-facing slopes just below the ridges and thin the exposed side.
